quest.title: Where the Heart Finds Rest
quest.description: The time when the Jade Chamber takes to the skies again is drawing closer. Who knows what will happen when it finally does?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Primogem x60, Mora x23425, Dragonheir's False Fin x2, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

chapter.title: The Crane Returns on the Wind

talks.objective: Give the Wonder Cores and Adepti Sigils to the secretary.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ningguang's little secretary! We've found all the materials!

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Oh? Already?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: All three of you found them together? Okay, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The Wonder Cores and Adepti Sigils look good. It seems that we've found our winners.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: #I hereby announce that the winners of this material procurement contest are {NICKNAME}, Yun Jin, and Beidou!

dialogues.speaker: Hongfei
dialogues.text: What? It's over already? I haven't even found the Plaustrite yet!

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: I can't believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Zhicheng
dialogues.text: *sigh* So close, but so far...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I'd like to invite our three winners to please proceed to the Jade Chamber, where Lady Ningguang is waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's Beidou? She was right here.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou has some business to attend to. She will join later. Please come with me for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright then, guess we'll head on up to the Jade Chamber first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This has been a long time coming! The last time we went up to the Jade Chamber was aaaages ago!

talks.objective: Talk to Ningguang at the Jade Chamber

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Combine the Adepti Sigils with the Wonder Cores and insert them into the Jade Chamber's control compartment.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The construction of the new Jade Chamber is now officially complete. Once the tethers are released, it will soar into the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Thank you all for your work. Now it is time for me to fulfill my promise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun, I've already heard something about the reason for your involvement. You are looking for a venue for your new opera, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: That's right. Lady Ningguang, I would like to hear your opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The unveiling of Ms. Yun's grand new opera surely requires a venue of equal grandeur. So what would you say if I proposed that we stage your first performance right here, in the newly built Jade Chamber?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The Jade Chamber offers a splendid panoramic view of the mountains and the bustling city. It is fitting for the finest performance to be hosted in the heavens... I can think of no better stage for you than here, Ms. Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Thank you, Lady Ningguang. Then I will prepare my props and other articles shortly. Please allow me to bring all these aboard the Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You're quite welcome. It's truly what a good opera deserves.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Shenhe, Paimon, I'll be leaving now. Do come and see my play when the time comes.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #You're next, {NICKNAME}. What is your question?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: #I should clarify. I do not know your {F#brother's}{M#sister's} whereabouts. So please, don't waste your question on this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... You're a mind-reader, Ningguang! Oh well, guess Paimon will ask a question then!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: ...Managing a successful business is not as simple as you might think. Capital, connections, sensitivity to the trends, an instinct for what is a good opportunity... All of these traits are crucial.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: If you want to know how to make money, I will honor our agreement and give you an answer. But that is not to say that it will work for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Paimon hadn't even asked the question yet!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Your question was written all over your face. Now look, you've helped me rebuild the Jade Chamber, and I intend to repay you handsomely for it.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: So I promise you that should you one day require financial assistance, you may seek employment here. I will pay you at the highest rate of remuneration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! So next time we run out of Mora, we just need to come to Ningguang!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No more questions from us. Shenhe, you got a question?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes! This was a group effort!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thank you... But I don't have anything to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Are you sure? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. I'd urge you not to squander it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, just don't waste it! Hold on a second, Paimon can probably think of another one...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang... do you think I can ever fit in in Liyue Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Now that is an interesting question.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is very inclusive. As long as you respect the rules here, you will not be turned away.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: So the key is whether or not you yourself can develop a sense of belonging in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: A sense of belonging?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Yes. To become fond of a place, to feel part of it... it always requires a reason.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Perhaps someone you've met or something you've experienced here. Or perhaps you enjoy the atmosphere of Liyue and you will become accustomed to it.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: In short, everyone needs a reason to stay. I hope you can find yours soon.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: ...I see.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey, what's going on? I just went to see the fleet, I'm a little later than expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, Beidou, it's your turn! Do you have a question for Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Me? Nah, I ain't got any questions. She forced me to help out, so I figured I may as well get involved with the contest.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ningguang, don't forget what we talked about.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It's not gonna be easy to deal with. I don't think my fleet can take it on their own.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I have made preparations. The wound dressings are ready and the Millelith have set up an ambush.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Glad to hear it. Watch your back. Stay alert!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou, Ningguang, what are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You'll see when the Jade Chamber ascends. However... it's not the most pleasant topic of conversation. Maybe it's better that you don't know.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: When I first set foot in the Jade Chamber, I stood at the edge of the platform and looked down upon Liyue Harbor far below.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: At that time, I dreamed that one day the Jade Chamber's shadow would be seen in all seven nations of Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: My wish has not changed to this very day. However, it is not only out of consideration for myself that I have built the Jade Chamber anew at this time.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I hope the Jade Chamber will always float in the skies above Liyue Harbor, bearing witness to the prosperity and peace of the human world...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: ...and I hope that you can all witness it with me.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Let the ascension ceremony commence!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: "To act, one must first feel"...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: After our trip to Mt. Tianheng together, I felt much more in touch with the character today. I believe I was able to deliver a more profound performance because of it.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Next time I have a new opera, may we study the character together again?

talks.objective: Defeat Beisht, "The Avenger of the Vortex"
Defeat Beisht, "The Avenger of the Vortex"

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The Millelith's casualties are within the range we expected.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But in hindsight, there were still flaws with our plan.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: If we'd had more time, we could have built a barrier here to absorb the impact of the waves.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: We must learn from this experience and never repeat the same mistakes again... We were fortunate to have your assistance this time. Thank you.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I'm just a little exhausted. Otherwise, fine.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I wanted to deal with it myself. I didn't expect you to follow me.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Don't worry. She's not coming back any time soon. After an injury like that, she'll likely seek refuge somewhere else.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: How did things go underwater?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: It's been dealt with. She was injured before entering the water. It didn't take too much effort to finish the job.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Good. So the crisis has been safely averted. When you visit the Jade Chamber in the future, you will be afforded generous treatment.

response.speaker: Zhengmao
response.text: Lady Ningguang, the fleet reports that the sea monster has left Guyun Stone Forest and the surrounding waters have returned to normal!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Thank you. How are the Millelith?

response.speaker: Zhengmao
response.text: Thanks to the medical supplies you prepared and Lady Keqing's command, our losses were minimal.

response.speaker: Zhengmao
response.text: Of course, we owe huge thanks to this young lady for her help.

response.speaker: Zhengmao
response.text: On behalf of the entire Millelith, thank you for your service.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Great. Then next time I watch Ms. Yun's opera, I'll be able to take the compliments.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I wasn't trying to be a hero, though. I just wanted to protect you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Let the soldiers recuperate. But don't let your guard down — if she returns with a vengeance, we must be prepared.

response.speaker: Zhengmao
response.text: Yes, Ma'am!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: You've been monitoring us for some time now. I trust you've reached a conclusion.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hmph. You wish to hear one's opinion? Well. Things would have hardly gone so smoothly had it not been for Shenhe.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: That I do not deny. However, final victory was always going to be ours, even had things been a little more arduous.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: If it came to it, I could always destroy another Jade Chamber.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: ...One has observed your adaptation of the Guizhong Ballista, and finds oneself compelled to admit that you have evidenced some degree of novel thinking.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: You have learned from past failures and prepared for this crisis in advance. This is considerable progress compared to the last time.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hence, on balance, one finds your performance during this trial satisfactory enough. But there will no doubt be further trials to come in the future. Do not suppose that one will not continue observing you hereafter.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: While the position of Tianquan remains mine, I will always ensure Liyue's safety.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Shenhe... One saw you secretly venture out from the mountains a few years ago, and noticed the air of dejection in which you returned.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Hopefully, this trip to Liyue Harbor has been a different experience?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Yes. I can't explain it, but...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I feel happier than I expected.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Good. Traveler, please take good care of Shenhe, she is a dear child.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: In fact, one has many fond memories of Shenhe's childhood that you may be interested to hear about...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: There'll be no need for that.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Oh? Hmph. They are all like this.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Fine! Since you care not to listen, one shan't be telling you. One shall be going homeward now!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Please have a good rest. Come to the Jade Chamber when you have recovered your energy.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: We must celebrate both the completion of the Jade Chamber and the fact that Liyue has weathered another crisis. This banquet must be the most spectacular ever.

choices.text: Just like the hero in the story.

talks.objective: Head to the Jade Chamber to take part in the victory feast

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Everyone's already seated!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Paimon's first time attending a banquet in the Jade Chamber! The food here looks amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: All of you here are my distinguished guests. I am determined that each of you thoroughly enjoys yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Those who don't drink alcohol, please help yourself to other beverages. Fine wine is a delight to the senses, but it is far from the only one. I trust you will find the marvelous view from the Jade Chamber to be an equally gratifying indulgence.

dialogues.speaker: Yongye
dialogues.text: Have you heard? Ms. Yun's going to be performing today.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: Sure have, honestly, it's the main reason I'm here! I've never missed any of Ms. Yun's performances and I don't intend to start now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: I hear she's going to perform "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" today, the one written by her father. I've been so excited that I've barely slept the last few nights.

dialogues.speaker: Shiyu
dialogues.text: Hey, look, Ms. Yun is going on stage!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: What did you think? Personally, I thought I sang rather well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was beautiful! Paimon wants to learn too!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It was wonderful. Also... Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: You're welcome. Thanks to you, The Divine Damsel of Devastation is a more nuanced tale than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The play has an ending, but life goes on. I believe you will find a way to fit in in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thank you. I think I've found the opportunity I needed to change.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun... *hic*... Here you are, great to see ya.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: Huh? Hey, this young lady with the white hair looks like some kind of VIP. Yeah, that's it, like an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: #Wait, you're the girl from the opera, aren't you? The "divine damsel" herself! And look who else we have here, the illustrious {NICKNAME}! Well I'll be... this was definitely worth showing up for.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: Lemme pull up a chair, alright? We'll all have a friendly chat, get better acquainted...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Alternatively, you could leave us alone. That is, if you'd prefer to finish your drink via the orifice of your own choice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, this feels all too familiar... Shenhe's back to her old self again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It seems she still has a long way to go.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: Hey! What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Calm down, Shenhe. Calm down...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, Paimon. I wasn't expecting to run into you out here at Guyun.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: What brings you here? You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid, I really can't afford to chat for too long.

choices.text: What are you doing out here?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: As you can see, we're working on a construction project.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Personally, I consider this project to be of greater importance than the Jade Chamber rebuild. That's why I'm here to supervise.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I just hope we can complete it on schedule...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: A new type of Guizhong Ballista.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ningguang commissioned an expert to dismantle and study the Guizhong Ballista, and design an improved version based on the original.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: This design is a step down from the adepti's original Guizhong Ballista in terms of firing speed and power, but the good thing about it is that it can be mass-produced.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's also considerably easier to assemble and disassemble. This will allow for flexible deployment, whatever the location.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'm confident it will prove very useful in dealing with future crises.

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: The Jade Chamber looks magnificent...

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: The fact we were able to complete the construction work on schedule is a testament to everyone's hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: The construction work on the Jade Chamber is now complete. Once we install the Wonder Cores and the Adepti Sigils, we can let it rise to altitude.

dialogues.speaker: Lizheng
dialogues.text: I don't know about anyone else, but this has been a challenging project for me... Let's get a drink after work.

dialogues.speaker: Siqin
dialogues.text: I can't wait to see the Jade Chamber ascend!

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Finally, we can relax a little. It's been quite stressful recently with so many people flocking here.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Fortunately, the construction here has gone off without a hitch. I can only hope the same is true for my comrades at Guyun Stone Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Qiqi! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Seaside. Dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Qiqi is helping. With the evacuation.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Yes. Ningguang said there's something bad in the sea.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: So she sent Qiqi, to evacuate everyone.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: But, no one will listen to Qiqi. So instead, Qiqi is guarding this place.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: If danger comes, Qiqi will protect everyone.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Don't go near the sea. It's too dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, I'm glad Master sent me here to deliver the sigils. Otherwise, I wouldn't have had the chance to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I'm sure I have much to learn from you in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You've made an exceptional contribution toward the building of the new Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I will not forget this. I shall be sure to repay your kindness at an appropriate juncture.

dialogues.speaker: Zhu Tao
dialogues.text: More wine, more wine!

dialogues.speaker: Yongye
dialogues.text: Drinking and watching opera in the Jade Chamber... a rare and exquisite pleasure.

dialogues.speaker: Shiyu
dialogues.text: I wonder when I'll be able to build a Jade Chamber of my own? *sigh* It'll take a lot more wealth than I have now.

dialogues.speaker: Shiyu
dialogues.text: But hey, you've gotta dream big. Who knows, if I keep working at it... Maybe one day.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can't let you be the only one taking this risk!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I hardly see this as a great risk. The people of Liyue Harbor are well-prepared and she is already badly injured. Only sheer willpower is keeping her alive.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I may be nearing the end of my stamina, but in a fight to the death... I think I have the upper hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll help, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's getting away! Shouldn't we go after her? \n

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: This place is unstable. It is too risky to continue pursuing her. \n

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If the place collapsed, the consequences would be disastrous... Let's head back.
